title: Accommodations by Disability Profile — Catalog
description: Index of accommodation files organized by disability profile or clinical presentation (Anxiety, Executive Function Disorder, Nonverbal Learning Disability). Use when the student's IEP indicates one of these profiles or shows characteristic presentations.

files.title: Accommodations for Students with Anxiety
files.description: Use when the student presents with generalized, social, performance, test, or OCD-related anxiety. Three sub-areas tagged via applies_when: classroom-environment, homework-tests, field-trips-other.

files.title: Accommodations and Strategies for Executive Function Disorder
files.description: Use when the student shows EF deficits — planning, organization, time management, working memory under task demands. Often co-occurs with ADHD.

files.title: Accommodations and Remediation Strategies for Nonverbal Learning Disability (NVLD)
files.description: Use when the student profile includes NVLD — strong verbal/rote skills with visual-spatial, social-pragmatic, and abstract-reasoning deficits. Includes remediation strategies (tagged applies_when: remediation-strategy).
